_about: One entry per pump set: the submitted one and its alternatives. Copy this file to data/projects/<project>/revit/candidates.json (git-ignored) and fill it from the data sheets. Leave a value null when the data sheet doesn't give it; never fill it from typical values. Sizes in mm, weight in kg, power in kW.

sets.model: the model code exactly as on the data sheet
sets.standby: pass, fail or null (from the standby test, MAF-19)
sets.dw_approval: true, false or null: an approval for contact with drinking water is in the package
sets.source: file and page the values come from
sets.status: extracted until a person has checked the values against the source, then verified
